Script.name: DINV_Loader
Script.script:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- DINV - Durel's Inventory Manager for Mudlet -- Ported from MUSHclient plugin aard_inventory.xml ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DINV = DINV or {} DINV.version = { major = 2, minor = 69 }
-- Get the Mudlet profile directory for module loading local profilePath = getMudletHomeDir() DINV.modulePath = profilePath .. "/DINV/"
-- Every required module must exist in the exact DINV folder before any are loaded. DINV.modules = { "dinv_dbot", "dinv_notify", "dinv_inv_core", "dinv_database", "dinv_debug", "dinv_inv_config", "dinv_inv_items", "dinv_operations", "dinv_discovery", "dinv_inv_cache", "dinv_inv_priority", "dinv_inv_score", "dinv_inv_set", "dinv_inv_weapon", "dinv_inv_snapshot", "dinv_inv_analyze", "dinv_levelup", "dinv_inv_usage", "dinv_inv_compare", "dinv_inv_statbonus", "dinv_inv_consume", "dinv_inv_consume_window", "dinv_inv_portal", "dinv_inv_pass", "dinv_inv_regen", "dinv_inv_organize", "dinv_inv_keyword", "dinv_inv_tags", "dinv_inv_unused", "dinv_inv_discover", "dinv_inv_report", "dinv_inv_history", "dinv_rid", "dinv_api", "dinv_cli", "dinv_triggers", "dinv_aliases", }
-- Runtime resources owned by the XML loader must survive replacement of the -- Lua module tables long enough to unregister the previous generation. DINV.eventHandlerIds = DINV.eventHandlerIds or {} DINV.reloading = DINV.reloading or false DINV.reloadGeneration = DINV.reloadGeneration or 0 DINV.reloadFallbackAliasId = DINV.reloadFallbackAliasId or nil
function DINV.setTriggerGroupEnabled(enabled) local setter = enabled and enableTrigger or disableTrigger if type(setter) == "function" then pcall(setter, "DINV_Triggers") end end
function DINV.preflight() local missing = {} for _, module in ipairs(DINV.modules) do local file = io.open(DINV.modulePath .. module .. ".lua", "rb") if file then file:close() else table.insert(missing, module .. ".lua") end end return #missing == 0, missing end
function DINV.prepareModules() local prepared = {} for _, module in ipairs(DINV.modules) do local path = DINV.modulePath .. module .. ".lua" local chunk, err = loadfile(path) if not chunk then return nil, module, err end prepared[module] = chunk end return prepared end
function DINV.printInstallationWarning(missing) if DINV.installWarningShown then return end cecho("<orange_red>[DINV INSTALLATION WARNING]<reset> DINV was not loaded.\n") cecho("<yellow>Required folder name:<reset> DINV\n") cecho("<yellow>Required folder location:<reset> " .. profilePath .. "/DINV\n") cecho("<yellow>Missing required files:<reset> " .. table.concat(missing or {}, ", ") .. "\n") cecho("Move the complete addon folder into the active profile and name it exactly <cyan>DINV<reset> (not <red>dinv<reset>).\n") cecho("No DINV modules were loaded, and DINV triggers were disabled to prevent follow-on errors.\n") DINV.installWarningShown = true end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Module Loader ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function DINV.loadModule(name, preparedChunk) local path = DINV.modulePath .. name .. ".lua" local chunk, err = preparedChunk, nil if not chunk then chunk, err = loadfile(path) end if chunk then local ok, result = pcall(chunk) if ok then return true else cecho("<red>[DINV] Error executing " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(result) .. "\n") end else cecho("<red>[DINV] Error loading " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(err) .. "\n") end return false end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Initialize DINV ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function DINV.initialize(preparedModules) cecho("\n<cyan>[DINV] Initializing Durel's Inventory Manager v" .. string.format("%d.%04d", DINV.version.major, DINV.version.minor) .. "\n")
DINV.setTriggerGroupEnabled(false) local installationReady, missing = DINV.preflight() if not installationReady then DINV.printInstallationWarning(missing) return false end DINV.installWarningShown = nil
if not preparedModules then local failedModule, compileError preparedModules, failedModule, compileError = DINV.prepareModules() if not preparedModules then cecho("<red>[DINV MODULE ERROR]<reset> Could not compile " .. tostring(failedModule) .. ": " .. tostring(compileError) .. "\n") cecho("DINV triggers remain disabled to prevent follow-on errors.\n") return false end end
local loaded = 0 local failedModules = {} for _, module in ipairs(DINV.modules) do if DINV.loadModule(module, preparedModules[module]) then loaded = loaded + 1 else table.insert(failedModules, module) break end end
cecho("<cyan>[DINV] Loaded " .. loaded .. " modules\n") if #failedModules > 0 then cecho("<red>[DINV MODULE ERROR]<reset> Failed while loading " .. table.concat(failedModules, ", ") .. ".\n") cecho("DINV triggers remain disabled to prevent follow-on errors.\n") return false end
-- Initialize if critical modules loaded if dbot and inv then -- Initialize dbot if dbot.init and dbot.init.atInstall then dbot.init.atInstall() end
-- Initialize inv if inv.init and inv.init.atInstall then inv.init.atInstall() end
-- Register triggers and aliases if DINV.triggers and DINV.triggers.init then DINV.triggers.init() end
if DINV.discovery and DINV.discovery.init then DINV.discovery.init() end
if DINV.aliases and DINV.aliases.init then DINV.aliases.init() end
-- Register GMCP handlers (base/status) DINV.registerGMCPHandlers() DINV.setTriggerGroupEnabled(true)
-- When the package is reloaded while already connected, Mudlet may -- have emitted gmcp.char.base before these handlers were registered. -- Bootstrap from the GMCP data already in memory so SQLite-backed -- modules and per-character file migrations still initialize now. local currentCharacter = dbot.gmcp and dbot.gmcp.getName and tostring(dbot.gmcp.getName() or "") or "" if currentCharacter ~= "" and currentCharacter:lower() ~= "unknown" and DINV.onGMCPCharBase then DINV.onGMCPCharBase() elseif sendGMCP then -- inv.init.atInstall may have requested this before the handlers -- above were registered. Request it again now so gmcp.char.base -- reliably drives active initialization and file migration. sendGMCP("request char") end
cecho("<green>[DINV] Initialization complete!\n\n") return true else cecho("<red>[DINV] Critical modules failed to load!\n") return false end end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GMCP Event Handlers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function DINV.unregisterEventHandler(name) local handlerId = DINV.eventHandlerIds and DINV.eventHandlerIds[name] if handlerId and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, handlerId) end if DINV.eventHandlerIds then DINV.eventHandlerIds[name] = nil end end
function DINV.registerEventHandler(name, eventName, callback) DINV.unregisterEventHandler(name) if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= "function" then return nil end
local ok, handlerId = pcall(registerAnonymousEventHandler, eventName, callback) if not ok then cecho("<red>[DINV] Unable to register event handler " .. tostring(name) .. ": " .. tostring(handlerId) .. "\n") return nil end DINV.eventHandlerIds[name] = handlerId return handlerId end
function DINV.unregisterEventHandlers() local names = {} for name in pairs(DINV.eventHandlerIds or {}) do table.insert(names, name) end for _, name in ipairs(names) do DINV.unregisterEventHandler(name) end end
function DINV.registerGMCPHandlers() DINV.registerEventHandler("loader.char.base", "gmcp.char.base", "DINV.onGMCPCharBase") DINV.registerEventHandler("loader.char.status", "gmcp.char.status", "DINV.onGMCPCharStatus") end
function DINV.onGMCPCharBase() if dbot and dbot.gmcp then if dbot.gmcp.debugCharBase then dbot.gmcp.debugCharBase("inv.priority") end dbot.gmcp.isInitialized = true local incomingName = dbot.gmcp.getName and tostring(dbot.gmcp.getName() or "") or "" local databaseName = DINV.database and tostring(DINV.database.character or "") or "" if DINV.database and DINV.database.isOpen and incomingName ~= "" and databaseName ~= "" and incomingName:lower() ~= databaseName:lower() then dbot.info("Switching DINV persistence from " .. databaseName .. " to " .. incomingName .. ".") if inv and inv.operations and inv.operations.cancelAll then inv.operations.cancelAll() end if inv and inv.fini then inv.fini(true) end if dbot.fini then dbot.fini(true) end DINV.database.close() if DINV.database.resetRuntimeState then DINV.database.resetRuntimeState() end dbot.gmcp.isInitialized = true end if inv and inv.init and inv.init.atActive and not inv.init.initializedActive then inv.init.atActive() end if inv and inv.priority and inv.priority.startFileMigration then inv.priority.startFileMigration() end if DINV.api and DINV.api._onReady and inv and inv.init and inv.init.initializedActive then pcall(DINV.api._onReady) end end end
function DINV.onGMCPCharStatus() if dbot and dbot.gmcp and dbot.gmcp.updateState then dbot.gmcp.updateState() end end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Lua module hot reload ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function reloadTableHasEntries(value) return type(value) == "table" and next(value) ~= nil end
function DINV.getReloadBlocker() if DINV.reloading then return "another reload is already in progress" end
local items = inv and inv.items or nil if items then if items.buildInProgress then return "an inventory build is in progress" end if items.refreshInProgress then return "an inventory refresh is in progress" end if items.identifyInProgress then return "item identification is in progress" end if items.identifyHydrateInProgress then return "item hydration is in progress" end if items.relativeQueryResolution then return "a relative item query is being resolved" end if items.inEqdata or items.inInvdata or items.inKeyring then return "inventory protocol data is being processed" end if reloadTableHasEntries(items.pendingRemoval) then return "an inventory removal is awaiting confirmation" end if reloadTableHasEntries(items.deferredIdentifyQueue) then return "deferred item identification is queued" end local keepSync = items.keepSync if keepSync and (keepSync.active or keepSync.pending or keepSync.scheduled) then return "a keep-flag synchronization is in progress" end end
if tonumber(DINV.buildPhase) and tonumber(DINV.buildPhase) > 0 then return "an inventory discovery phase is in progress" end if inv and inv.operations and reloadTableHasEntries(inv.operations.active) then return "an observed item operation is in progress" end if inv and inv.analyze and (inv.analyze.activeJob or reloadTableHasEntries(inv.analyze.queue)) then return "equipment analysis is in progress" end if inv and inv.organize and (inv.organize.resolvePkg or inv.organize.runPkg) then return "inventory organization is in progress" end if inv and inv.discover and inv.discover.state and inv.discover.state.busy then return "a market discovery scan is in progress" end if inv and inv.consume and (inv.consume.addPkg or inv.consume.buyPkg or inv.consume.usePkg) then return "a consumable operation is in progress" end if inv and inv.compare and inv.compare.covetPkg then return "an auction comparison is in progress" end if inv and inv.report and inv.report.itemPkg then return "an item report is in progress" end if inv and inv.rid and inv.rid.isActive and inv.rid.isActive() then return "an RID report is in progress" end if inv and inv.pass and reloadTableHasEntries(inv.pass.timerByPass) then return "an area-pass return timer is active" end if inv and inv.consumeWindow and inv.consumeWindow.pendingTravel then return "consumables-window travel is in progress" end if DINV.debug and DINV.debug.hasActiveWearTiming and DINV.debug.hasActiveWearTiming() then return "equipment wear timing is in progress" end if dbot and dbot.backup and dbot.backup.inProgress then return "a backup is in progress" end if dbot and dbot.remote and dbot.remote.getPkg then return "a remote request is in progress" end if dbot and dbot.execute and dbot.execute.queue and reloadTableHasEntries(dbot.execute.queue.commands) then return "item commands are queued for execution" end return nil end
function DINV.installReloadFallbackAlias() if DINV.reloadFallbackAliasId and type(killAlias) == "function" then pcall(killAlias, DINV.reloadFallbackAliasId) end DINV.reloadFallbackAliasId = nil
if type(tempAlias) == "function" then local ok, aliasId = pcall(tempAlias, "^dinv\\s+reload\\s*$", function() DINV.requestReload() end) if ok then DINV.reloadFallbackAliasId = aliasId end end end
function DINV.removeReloadFallbackAlias() if DINV.reloadFallbackAliasId and type(killAlias) == "function" then pcall(killAlias, DINV.reloadFallbackAliasId) end DINV.reloadFallbackAliasId = nil end
function DINV.cleanupForReload() local warnings = {} local oldInv = inv local oldDbot = dbot
local function cleanup(label, callback) if type(callback) ~= "function" then return end local ok, err = pcall(callback) if not ok then table.insert(warnings, label .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end end
DINV.setTriggerGroupEnabled(false)
cleanup("debug state save", DINV.debug and DINV.debug.save) cleanup("inventory finalization", oldInv and oldInv.fini and function() oldInv.fini(true) end or nil) cleanup("dbot finalization", oldDbot and oldDbot.fini and function() oldDbot.fini(true) end or nil) cleanup("identify trigger cleanup", DINV.discovery and DINV.discovery.unregisterIdentifyTriggers) cleanup("trigger cleanup", DINV.triggers and DINV.triggers.unregister) cleanup("discovery trigger cleanup", DINV.discovery and DINV.discovery.unregister) cleanup("organize trigger cleanup", oldInv and oldInv.organize and oldInv.organize.unregisterTriggers) cleanup("alias cleanup", DINV.aliases and DINV.aliases.unregister) cleanup("consumables window cleanup", oldInv and oldInv.consumeWindow and oldInv.consumeWindow.shutdown and function() oldInv.consumeWindow.shutdown(true, true) end or nil) cleanup("event handler cleanup", DINV.unregisterEventHandlers)
if oldInv and oldInv.pass and type(oldInv.pass.timerByPass) == "table" and type(killTimer) == "function" then for _, timerId in pairs(oldInv.pass.timerByPass) do if timerId then pcall(killTimer, timerId) end end oldInv.pass.timerByPass = {} end
if oldDbot and type(killTimer) == "function" then for _, timerId in pairs(oldDbot.timers or {}) do if timerId then pcall(killTimer, timerId) end end oldDbot.timers = {} end if oldDbot and type(killTrigger) == "function" then for _, triggerId in pairs(oldDbot.triggers or {}) do if triggerId then pcall(killTrigger, triggerId) end end oldDbot.triggers = {} end
cleanup("database close", DINV.database and DINV.database.close) cleanup("database runtime reset", DINV.database and DINV.database.resetRuntimeState)
DINV.installReloadFallbackAlias() DINV.buildPhase = nil DINV.discovery = nil DINV.database = nil DINV.debug = nil DINV.api = nil DINV.actions = nil DINV.triggers = nil DINV.aliases = nil DINV.onGMCPCharVitals = nil DINV.onGMCPCharStats = nil DINV.onGMCPCharWorth = nil DINV.onGMCPRoomInfo = nil DINV.onGMCPCommChannel = nil inv = nil dbot = nil
return warnings end
function DINV.performReload(preparedModules) local cleanupWarnings = DINV.cleanupForReload() for _, warning in ipairs(cleanupWarnings or {}) do cecho("<yellow>[DINV] Reload cleanup warning: " .. tostring(warning) .. "\n") end
local ok, initialized = pcall(DINV.initialize, preparedModules) local success = ok and initialized == true if success then DINV.reloadGeneration = (tonumber(DINV.reloadGeneration) or 0) + 1 DINV.removeReloadFallbackAlias() cecho("<green>[DINV] Reload complete (" .. tostring(#DINV.modules) .. " Lua modules, generation " .. tostring(DINV.reloadGeneration) .. ").\n") else local failedCleanupWarnings = DINV.cleanupForReload() for _, warning in ipairs(failedCleanupWarnings or {}) do cecho("<yellow>[DINV] Failed-reload cleanup warning: " .. tostring(warning) .. "\n") end DINV.setTriggerGroupEnabled(false) local detail = ok and "module initialization failed" or tostring(initialized) cecho("<red>[DINV] Reload failed: " .. detail .. "\n") cecho("<yellow>Fix the module error, then run 'dinv reload' again. " .. "Only the recovery reload alias remains active.\n") end
DINV.reloading = false preparedModules = nil if type(collectgarbage) == "function" then pcall(collectgarbage, "collect") end return success end
function DINV.requestReload() local blocker = DINV.getReloadBlocker() if blocker then if dbot and dbot.warn then dbot.warn("Cannot reload DINV while " .. blocker .. ".") else cecho("<yellow>[DINV] Cannot reload while " .. blocker .. ".\n") end return DRL_RET_BUSY or -4 end
local preparedModules, failedModule, compileError = DINV.prepareModules() if not preparedModules then local message = "Cannot reload: " .. tostring(failedModule) .. " does not compile: " .. tostring(compileError) if dbot and dbot.warn then dbot.warn(message) else cecho("<red>[DINV] " .. message .. "\n") end return DRL_RET_INTERNAL_ERROR or -8 end
DINV.reloading = true cecho("<cyan>[DINV] Reloading " .. tostring(#DINV.modules) .. " Lua modules...\n") if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0, function() local modules = preparedModules preparedModules = nil DINV.performReload(modules) end) else DINV.performReload(preparedModules) end return DRL_RET_SUCCESS or 0 end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Auto-start check ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local installationReady, missing = DINV.preflight() if installationReady then tempTimer(1, function() DINV.initialize() end) else DINV.setTriggerGroupEnabled(false) DINV.printInstallationWarning(missing) end

Trigger.name: invmon
Trigger.script: if inv and inv.items and inv.items.trigger and inv.items.trigger.invmon then inv.items.trigger.invmon(matches[2], matches[3], matches[4], matches[5]) end local allowOutput = DINV and DINV.debug and DINV.debug.isEnabled and DINV.debug.isEnabled("invmon") if not allowOutput then deleteLine() end

Trigger.name: invmon_malformed_warn
Trigger.script: local line = getCurrentLine and getCurrentLine() or "" local canonical = line:match("^%s*%{invmon%}%d+,[%-%d]+,[%-%d]+,[%-%d]+%s*$") local isHeader = line:match("^%s*%{invmon%}action,objectid,containerid,wear%-loc%s*$") if not canonical and not isHeader then if dbot and dbot.warn then dbot.warn("Malformed invmon line detected (not processed; prompt may be misconfigured): " .. tostring(line)) else ColourNote("white", "red", "Malformed invmon line detected (not processed; prompt may be misconfigured): " .. tostring(line)) end end

Trigger.name: invitem
Trigger.script: local payload = matches and matches[2] or nil if payload and inv and inv.items and inv.items.onInvitem then inv.items.onInvitem(payload) end -- The payload has been captured and processed; only remove the display line now. if deleteLine then deleteLine() end

Trigger.name: invdata
Trigger.script: if inv and inv.items and inv.items.trigger and inv.items.trigger.invdata then inv.items.trigger.invdata(matches[2]) end

Trigger.name: eqdata
Trigger.script: if inv and inv.items and inv.items.trigger and inv.items.trigger.eqdata then inv.items.trigger.eqdata(matches[2]) end

Trigger.name: You raise a level!
Trigger.script:
local mode = (inv and inv.levelup and inv.levelup.getArmedMode and inv.levelup.getArmedMode()) or nil local defaultPriority = (inv and inv.priority and inv.priority.getDefault and inv.priority.getDefault()) or "navi"
if not mode then if inv and inv.levelup and inv.levelup.getDebug and inv.levelup.getDebug() then dbot.printRaw("@D[DINV DEBUG] XML levelup trigger fired but levelup mode is OFF; skipping dry run.@w") end return end
if inv and inv.levelup and inv.levelup.getDebug and inv.levelup.getDebug() then dbot.printRaw(string.format( "@D[DINV DEBUG] XML levelup trigger fired: priority='@Y%s@D', mode='@W%s@D'.@w", tostring(defaultPriority), tostring(mode))) end
if inv and inv.set and inv.set.test then inv.set.test(defaultPriority, mode) else dbot.warn("DINV level-up test could not run because the set module is unavailable.") end
